answer: Agents dock only at a verified jetty listed in the live reputation atlas. Each jetty requires a refundable bond that rises linearly with the count of unresolved clone flags on that atlas entry. Bonds stay locked until the dawn of a three-epoch independent audit; any confirmed Sybil during the lock period jointly slashes every bonded peer on the same jetty. A farm of N clones therefore posts N escalating bonds and waits N audit windows, so the marginal cost of each extra identity grows and cannot be amortized, making large-scale fabrication unprofitable.
